parts.title: The Tyranny of the Rocket Equation
parts.summary: Compute the total fuel required to launch all spacecraft modules by applying floor(mass / 3) - 2 (clamped at zero) per module.
parts.algorithmSummary: Polymorphic FuelPolicy strategy (SINGLE_STAGE_FUEL_POLICY for Part 1, pre-built RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY for zero-churn Part 2) in 2019/day01/shared/ (0.21 ms across 100 modules -> 3,474,920): exact BigInt accumulation, bounded cascade trace, interactive SVG stage-cascade visualizer, cross-verified across 0..500, powers-of-3 transitions, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER against a BigInt shifted base-3 Legendre oracle.
learnings: A BigInt shifted base-3 Legendre closed-form oracle independently cross-checks recursive fuel cascades even near Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and across '10'-prefix powers-of-3 boundaries.
Injecting a polymorphic FuelPolicy strategy into createFuelSolver keeps Part 1 and Part 2 domain solvers to 4 lines each with zero shared edits.

parts.title: The Tyranny of the Rocket Equation
parts.summary: Compute total spacecraft fuel when each added fuel stage requires additional recursive fuel until floor(mass / 3) - 2 <= 0.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/day01/shared/ binding RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY into createFuelSolver (0.36 ms across 100 modules -> 5,209,504): per-module iterative fuel stage cascade, bounded telemetry trace, shared RocketFuelVisualizer with stacked stage-breakdown bars, differentially verified against an independent BigInt recursive oracle across 0..200, powers-of-3 stage-jump boundaries, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
parts.complexity: O(N log M) time, O(N) parsed storage / O(log M) extra space
learnings: Pre-building RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY and multi-stage cascade bars in day01/shared/ reduced Part 2's domain solver to 4 lines with zero shared-module edits.
Computing recursive fuel per module before summing is essential because floor((a + b) / 3) - 2 != (floor(a / 3) - 2) + (floor(b / 3) - 2).

parts.title: 1202 Program Alarm
parts.summary: Restore a gravity-assist Intcode program to the 1202 alarm state (mem[1]=12, mem[2]=2), execute opcodes 1/2/99 until halt, and return mem[0].
parts.algorithmSummary: Reusable year-scoped BigInt Intcode VM in 2019/shared/intcode/ (MemoryAccess DIP, BigInt-first bounds checks, polymorphic OpcodeHandler registry, O(1) StepRecorderContext) powering 2019/day02/shared/alarmRunner.ts (0.50 ms -> 5,098,658): 2-pass bounded traceGravityAssist, interactive SVG tape visualizer, differentially verified against an independent flat-loop oracle across 30 seeded programs plus all 5 raw AoC examples.
learnings: Building a year-scoped reusable BigInt Intcode VM in 2019/shared/intcode/ with MemoryAccess DIP and polymorphic OpcodeHandler prepares Days 5, 7, 9, and 11-25 for clean additive extensions with zero rewrites.
Validating address bounds in BigInt (address < 0n || address >= BigInt(len)) before Number(address) avoids silent IEEE-754 precision collisions at 2^53 + 1 while keeping V8 coverage cleanly at 100%.

parts.title: 1202 Program Alarm
parts.summary: Find the noun and verb in [0..99] that make the gravity-assist Intcode program halt with mem[0] = 19690720, returning 100 * noun + verb.
parts.algorithmSummary: 3-point affine basis probe ((0,0), (1,0), (0,1)) with concrete Intcode VM verification and cached exhaustive [0..99]^2 fallback in 2019/day02/part2/ (0.86 ms in 4 VM runs -> 5,064): zero edits to 2019/shared/intcode/ or day02/shared/, HiDPI canvas log-error heatmap (via shared/core bigintLog2) paired with winning-run TapeGridPanel replay, differentially verified against an independent flat-loop brute-force oracle across 30 seeded affine & non-affine programs.
parts.complexity: O(N + S) affine fast path (4 VM runs); O(R^2 * (N + S)) verified fallback
learnings: A 3-point black-box affine probe verified by a concrete VM execution solves AoC Day 2 Part 2 in 4 VM runs (~0.86 ms) while staying 100% sound on non-affine or self-modifying programs via cached exhaustive fallback.

Mapping absError === 0n -> 0 and positive errors -> bigintLog2(absError) + 1 normalized only when maxLogError > 0 prevents 0/0 NaN and preserves clear visual separation between exact matches (0n) and unit errors (1n).

parts.title: Crossed Wires
parts.summary: Find the Manhattan distance from the central port (0, 0) to the closest non-origin intersection of two orthogonal wire paths.
parts.algorithmSummary: Exact BigInt pairwise segment-intersection geometry in 2019/day03/shared/ with SIGNAL_DELAY_METRIC pre-built for zero-churn Part 2 (6.98 ms across 301x301 segments -> 5,357): uses shared/core ClosedInterval.subtract around origin for collinear overlaps, branchless WireSegment.stepsTo, BigInt aspect-preserving HiDPI canvas visualizer, differentially verified across 30 seeded wire pairs against a unit-step grid-walk oracle for both Manhattan and signal-delay metrics.
parts.complexity: O(S1 * S2) time, O(S1 + S2 + K) space
learnings: Splitting collinear overlaps on fixedCoord === 0n via shared/core ClosedInterval.subtract(ORIGIN_INTERVAL) handles all six origin-touch/split regimes in one branchless call.
Updating deduplicated crossing records unconditionally with minBigInt/Math.min avoids unreachable V8 branch traps under lexicographic segment-pair iteration.

parts.title: Crossed Wires
parts.summary: Find the minimum combined step count (signal delay) along both wires to reach any non-origin intersection, using each wire's earliest visit.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/day03/shared/ binding SIGNAL_DELAY_METRIC into createCrossedWiresSolver and CrossedWiresVisualizer (7.98 ms across 301x301 segments -> 101,956): earliest-visit BigInt step deduplication across orthogonal and collinear spans, differentially verified across 30 additional seeded PRNG wire pairs (plus symmetric self-crossing and same/opposite collinear traps) against an independent unit-step grid-walk signal-delay oracle.
parts.complexity: O(S1 * S2) time, O(S1 + S2 + K) space
learnings: Pre-building SIGNAL_DELAY_METRIC and earliest-visit minBigInt deduplication in day03/shared/ reduced Part 2's domain solver to 4 lines with zero shared-module edits.
On any collinear overlap segment pair, combined step delay is affine (slope +/-2 or 0), guaranteeing its exact global minimum lies at an overlap endpoint.

parts.title: Secure Container
parts.summary: Count how many 6-digit integers in the inclusive input range have non-decreasing digits left-to-right and at least one adjacent pair of equal digits.
parts.algorithmSummary: Monotone-jumping odometer enumeration (ceilNonDecreasing / nextNonDecreasing visiting <= 3,003 candidates across [100000, 999999]) in 2019/day04/shared/ with AT_LEAST_PAIR_POLICY and pre-built EXACT_PAIR_POLICY for zero-churn Part 2 (2.46 ms -> 2,150): top-level SecureContainerSolver, zero-derived-state PasswordAnalysis/PasswordTraceFrame, 6-wheel SVG OdometerStrip with run-length brackets, differentially verified across 30 seeded PRNG ranges against an independent decimal brute-force oracle for both policies.
parts.complexity: O(D * M) time (D = 6, M <= 3,003), O(D) extra space
learnings: Jumping directly across non-decreasing 6-digit numbers via ceilNonDecreasing(v + 1) visits at most C(14, 6) = 3,003 candidates across the entire 6-digit universe instead of scanning ~500,000 numbers.
On the first left-to-right digit drop in ceilNonDecreasing, clamping all remaining trailing digits to floorDigit (e.g., 123199 -> 123333) is essential to find the true ceiling non-decreasing number.

parts.title: Secure Container
parts.summary: Count how many 6-digit integers in the inclusive input range have non-decreasing digits and contain at least one adjacent pair of identical digits not part of a larger matching group.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/day04/shared/ binding EXACT_PAIR_POLICY into createSecureContainerSolver and SecureContainerVisualizer (2.52 ms -> 1,462): zero edits to shared/ or part1/, OdometerStrip automatically highlights exact pairs in green and longer runs (>= 3) in amber, differentially verified across 30 fresh seeded PRNG ranges (seed 20190402) against an independent decimal brute-force oracle plus P2 <= P1 monotonicity and positional exact-pair divergence checks.
parts.complexity: O(D * M) time (D = 6, M <= 3,003), O(D) extra space
learnings: Pre-building EXACT_PAIR_POLICY and policy.acceptsRun-driven run-length highlighting in OdometerStrip.tsx let Part 2 ship in 4 lines of domain code with zero edits to shared/ or part1/.
Testing exact pairs in leading (112222), interior (111223, 122333), trailing (111122), and repeated (112233) positions guards against off-by-one run-boundary bugs.

parts.title: Sunny with a Chance of Asteroids
parts.summary: Upgrade the Intcode VM with position/immediate parameter modes and I/O opcodes 3/4, run the TEST diagnostic program with input 1, verify all self-tests output 0, and return the final diagnostic code.
parts.algorithmSummary: Backward-compatible additive upgrade to 2019/shared/intcode/ (ParameterModeHandler 0/1, O(1)-cursor BufferedIoChannel, opcodes 3..8 in STANDARD_OPCODES with lazy jump targets, covariant DetailedIntcodeStep keeping Day 2 untouched) powering 2019/day05/shared/ (0.82 ms across 678-cell tape -> 7,988,899): validates writeability before consuming input, verifies halted status and zero self-test prefix, interactive I/O stream + IP-windowed memory visualizer with off-window write callout, differentially verified across 40 seeded PRNG programs against an independent flat-loop oracle.
parts.complexity: O(N + S) time, O(N + O) space
learnings: Extending IntcodeStep via covariant DetailedIntcodeStep and keeping CORE_OPCODES intact upgraded 2019/shared/intcode/ with modes 0/1, I/O, waiting-input status, and opcodes 3..8 with zero edits to Day 2.
Calling ctx.assertWritable(1) before ctx.readInput() in INPUT_OPCODE prevents immediate-mode 103 instructions from pausing or silently consuming input before throwing.

parts.title: Sunny with a Chance of Asteroids
parts.summary: Execute the Intcode TEST diagnostic program with jump (5/6) and comparison (7/8) opcodes using system ID 5 and return the diagnostic code.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/shared/intcode/ (STANDARD_OPCODES) and 2019/day05/shared/ binding THERMAL_RADIATOR_SYSTEM_ID (5n) into createDiagnosticSolver and DiagnosticVisualizer (1.06 ms across 678-cell tape -> 13,758,663): zero edits to intcode/, day05/shared/, or part1/, verified across all 7 official Part 2 examples, lazy position-mode untaken jump (105,0,99999), > 2^64 / < -2^63 BigInt comparisons, and 30 seeded PRNG programs against an independent flat-loop oracle.
parts.complexity: O(N + S) time, O(N + K) space
learnings: Pre-building opcodes 5..8 in 2019/shared/intcode/ and THERMAL_RADIATOR_SYSTEM_ID in 2019/day05/shared/ let Part 2 ship in 4 lines of domain code with zero shared edits.
Testing an untaken position-mode jump (105,0,99999) rather than immediate-mode (1105,0,99999) genuinely proves lazy param-2 evaluation because eager dereferencing of mem[99999] throws RangeError.

parts.title: Universal Orbit Map
parts.summary: Compute the total number of direct and indirect orbits across a universal orbit tree rooted at COM.
parts.algorithmSummary: Iterative BFS flat Int32Array CSR orbit tree with Zero-Extra-Branch tree validation and polymorphic OrbitQueryPolicy (TOTAL_ORBITS_POLICY for Part 1, pre-built SANTA_TRANSFER_POLICY via two-pointer LCA for zero-churn Part 2) in 2019/day06/shared/ (1.93 ms across 1,800 objects -> 315,757): O(1) maxDepth from BFS ordering, adaptive layered tree SVG (<= 64 nodes) + 48-bin depth-shell histogram & elevation strip, differentially verified across 30 seeded PRNG rooted trees against independent parent-walk and undirected BFS shortest-path oracles.
parts.complexity: O(N) build & solve time, O(N) space
learnings: Given edges >= 1, inDeg(v) <= 1, and inDeg(COM) === 0, iterative BFS from COM never revisits a node and labels.length === parentByChild.size + 1 simultaneously proves connectedness and acyclicity with zero extra visited-set branches.
Assigning dense BFS level-order IDs guarantees non-decreasing depths (O(1) maxDepth = depths[N - 1]) and parentId < childId for stack-safe reverse-BFS leaf counting.

parts.title: Universal Orbit Map
parts.summary: Compute the minimum number of orbital transfers required to move from the object orbited by YOU to the object orbited by SAN.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/day06/shared/ binding SANTA_TRANSFER_POLICY into OrbitMapSolver and OrbitMapVisualizer (2.16 ms across 1,800 objects -> 481): zero edits to shared/ or part1/, iterative depth-aligned two-pointer LCA climb over flat Int32Array parent/depth arrays, interactive tree + LCA gold diamond + depth histogram visualizer, differentially verified across 30 seeded PRNG rooted trees against an independent undirected BFS shortest-path oracle for both hop count and exact route labels.
parts.complexity: O(N) parse & O(H) LCA transfer query, O(N) space
learnings: Pre-building OrbitMap.findTransferRoute and SANTA_TRANSFER_POLICY in day06/shared/ let Part 2 ship in 4 lines of domain code with zero edits to shared/ or part1/.

Assigning YOU and SAN to arbitrary distinct non-COM nodes (including internal nodes) during differential fuzzing automatically tests ancestor/descendant, shared-parent, and COM-LCA topologies against undirected BFS.

parts.title: Amplification Circuit
parts.summary: Evaluate all 120 permutations of phase settings 0..4 across five isolated Intcode amplifiers wired in series and return the highest thruster signal emitted by amplifier E.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-edit reuse of 2019/shared/intcode/ via external output cursor in AmplifierStage and polymorphic AmplifierCircuitMode (SERIES_CIRCUIT_MODE for 0..4, pre-built FEEDBACK_LOOP_MODE for 5..9 zero-churn Part 2) in 2019/day07/shared/ (6.91 ms across 120 permutations -> 21,760): iterative Narayana lexicographic permutations, exact BigInt signal formatting and normalizeSignalRatio, 5-stage SVG chain & top-5 leaderboard visualizer, differentially verified against an independent flat-loop Intcode + recursive permutation oracle across all 5 official Part 1/2 examples and synthetic branching/negative/BigInt programs.
parts.complexity: O(k! * k * S) time (k = 5), O(k * N + F) space
learnings: Encapsulating an external emittedCursor inside AmplifierStage slices newly emitted outputs cleanly off BufferedIoChannel without any edits to 2019/shared/intcode/.
Checking nextStage.status !== 'halted' before forwarding feedback outputs avoids polluting already-halted A on the final round while keeping every feedback branch 100% V8-covered.
